scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/shared
